issues.reason: The 'Every time / whenever' rule mandates the trigger clause as the premises and the response as a per-occurrence Skolem consequent, so with (Member $k keeper) as the sole premise the rule derives the spreading, the feather group, the lit lantern and the shielding for every keeper — asserting occurrences the sentence only conditions on.

The noun-modifier half would bar exposure outright, but under the equally available participle-of-grind reading 'ground' is an adjectival property passing the stated predication test, so in territory the gradable/positional/material exposure list genuinely leaves undecided the definitional atom is true and well-typed — acceptable improvisation under the calibration line rather than a second defect.

gaps_confirmed: participial modifier inside a compound kind ('ground feathers'): neither the adjective+noun fusion list (term of art / nationality / role title / material) nor the modifier-genus exposure list (gradable / positional / material) decides participial adjectives, so whether to fuse and whether to expose are both open
